candidate_statement.left_predicate: A represented unary predicate A typed on U.
candidate_statement.right_predicate: A represented unary predicate B typed on U.
candidate_statement.disjointness: No represented x in U satisfies both A(x) and B(x).
candidate_statement.semantic_level: Pure first-order/Core-definable predicate disjointness; A and B meanings remain unresolved external predicates.

intended_W_binding.B: REAL_POINT-like source predicate, semantics not defined by the candidate

The post-G7 G5 review identifies the absence clause as a candidate logical decomposition while requiring conic-point and real-point semantics to remain explicit lower demands.
prohibited_evidence: historical W real-conic closure packets as authority
defining REAL_POINT by conjugation or fixed-point semantics
defining CONIC_POINT from projective equations absent from the current source graph
predicted_consequences: The common carrier may be empty.
The candidate does not imply that A or B is the complement of the other.
Any represented element satisfying both predicates falsifies the candidate.
Qualification cannot close the meanings of A or B; those remain lower semantic demands.
G7 must independently justify that W097's phrase supplies the two predicate roles and common point-domain typing.
known_alternatives: Preserve W-SSC-097-O05 as an opaque absence relation.
Reopen W097 source granularity to expose explicit point-membership predicates before consumption.
Use a source-specific real-conic module only if separately sourced and qualified.
positive_controls: nonempty disjoint A/B on a three-element carrier
negative_adversarial_controls: one element in both A and B
falsifiers: Any lawful empty/partial model rejected because complement/exhaustiveness/nonemptiness leaked in.
Any need to define A or B using projective, real-form, conjugation, or geometry semantics.
Failure at G7 to source-establish two predicate roles over one represented point domain.
adaptive_evidence: The candidate was selected after schema 221101 closed W097 O06/O04 and the post-G7 G5 replay ranked O05 as the next material W-only residual.
coverage_limits: Only generic typed predicate disjointness. No semantics of conic, realness, complexness, projective geometry, or point existence.
